title: Alignment Tax Formalization: Do Theoretical Safety Constraints Have Consistent Performance Costs?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: if alignment tax varies systematically with constraint type, practitioners can choose the lowest-cost constraint for their setting. Directly actionable for deployment decisions and cost-benefit analysis of safety methods.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Implementing five different alignment constraints (output filtering, activation regularization, behavioral cloning, constitutional AI revision, CCS probe guidance) is a massive implementation burden. Each method requires separate expertise. Far too many methods for a beginner team.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Five constraint types times three benchmarks = 15 experimental cells, plus a base model baseline. This is a large-scale empirical comparison that would take a research team months, not 30 hours.
